definitions.proxy: First cumulative p>=q bin; finite central interval uses uniform-density interpolation. Open-tail bins abstain even at boundary. Model p is row-renormalized only for proxy quantiles.
definitions.truth: Previously verified raw QC type7-compatible q25/q50/q75; IQR and Bowley computed per original sample.
definitions.absolute_shape: Raw IQR>=1 and Bowley<=-.30 or >=+.30; no original source-percentile condition.
definitions.aggregation: Each row metric -> same T within group mean -> equal groups. Missing proxy metrics excluded only from that metric and support reported; common support supplied separately.
definitions.confusion: Full row events with distinct T/groups plus ratios of group-balanced TP/FP/FN masses; rejected positives remain FN.
definitions.oracle: True63 under the same within-bin-uniform inverse-CDF rule. Assumption-based reference; not best attainable or irreducible error lower bound. Includes quantile-estimator convention differences.

limits: All observations are previously exposed development; neither final-test claims nor source-population extreme screening.
Two seeds are reported separately on the same samples; no seed-as-independent-n pooling or best-seed selection.
Multiple target views remain separate. No probability or raw shape averaging; fixed canonical-row scores used only for T-budget ranking and any-view raw truth is explicit.
No mode classification, AP/PR sweep, model loading, new fit or raw phi matrix access.

fixed_one_percent_ranking.truth_selection: Any raw view of the T satisfies the same-direction absolute condition; raw views remain separate elsewhere
fixed_one_percent_ranking.population: Exposed development T pool, not historical source population percentiles
